texts.label: text
texts.orig: The eDRAULIC ®  3.0 rescue tools have a smart dashboard that provides up-to-the-minute feedback on the tools status. On E3 Connect tools connected to Wi-Fi, it can transfer this information as well as any tool and battery alerts to the Captium ™  cloud. Also, Captium can inform you of any needed preventative maintenance. Plus, it has the industry's first patented watertight design for fresh and salt water and a new turbo feature for faster rescue times. You can't help but be unstoppable.

texts.label: text
texts.orig: With intuitive blade designs engineered to pull material to the center of the blades, industry-leading cutting force at the point of attack and leading ergonomic design, HURST Jaws of Life ®  cutters are undeniably the industry standard.
texts.text: With intuitive blade designs engineered to pull material to the center of the blades, industry-leading cutting force at the point of attack and leading ergonomic design, HURST Jaws of Life ®  cutters are undeniably the industry standard.

texts.label: text
texts.orig: Years ago, industry challengers began hyping 'maximum cutting force' as the key selling point when considering cutters. This created an inaccurate standard of - the more force, the better.
texts.text: Years ago, industry challengers began hyping 'maximum cutting force' as the key selling point when considering cutters. This created an inaccurate standard of - the more force, the better.

texts.label: text
texts.orig: This focus on 'maximum cutting force' has created confusion in the marketplace regarding how cutting forces are calculated, why advertised cutting forces may vary from National Fire Protection Agency (NFPA) guidelines and how some manufacturers inflate cutting-force measurements for marketing purposes. For true comparison of cutting capability, rescuers should use the NFPA cutter ratings.
texts.text: This focus on 'maximum cutting force' has created confusion in the marketplace regarding how cutting forces are calculated, why advertised cutting forces may vary from National Fire Protection Agency (NFPA) guidelines and how some manufacturers inflate cutting-force measurements for marketing purposes. For true comparison of cutting capability, rescuers should use the NFPA cutter ratings.

texts.label: text
texts.orig: In the HURST Jaws of Life testing lab, our engineers calculate force measurements based on known facts, and then conduct real-world tests with production-grade tools to verify the data. And finally, we make sure our products are tested, retested and tested again, until we are completely certain they can handle even the toughest emergency rescues.
texts.text: In the HURST Jaws of Life testing lab, our engineers calculate force measurements based on known facts, and then conduct real-world tests with production-grade tools to verify the data. And finally, we make sure our products are tested, retested and tested again, until we are completely certain they can handle even the toughest emergency rescues.
